items.title: 14.5 Fiza par insani sargarmiyon ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Insani activities atmosphere par bohat asar dalti hain, khaas taur par fossil fuels jalane aur deforestation (jangal kaatne) ke zariye. In se climate change, air pollution, kharab air quality aur doosre environmental masail paida hote hain.

Shehri (urban) ilaqon mein zyada tar air pollution insani sources se aati hai. Yeh sources mobile (cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, samandari engines) ya point sources (factories, bijli ghar waghaira) hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Chaar insani activities batayein jo air quality kharab karti hain, aur har ek ka ek pollutant likhein.
blocks.explanation: Gariyon mein fuel jalana: CO, NOₓ, VOCs. Bijli gharon aur bhattiyon mein coal jalana: SO₂ aur PM. Jangal kaatna aur fasal ki baqiyat jalana: CO₂ aur dhuen ke zarre. Factories, metallurgy aur koora jalana: lead aur mercury jaisi heavy metals.

items: Insani asar zyada tar fossil fuels jalane aur deforestation se; shehron mein pollution mobile aur point sources se.
